name: Novita AI serverless endpoints
price_basis: USD per 1M TOKENS, representative model meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct, observed 2026-10-14 on OpenRouter's provider table ($0.135 in / $0.40 out - the second-cheapest row there, behind only DeepInfra Turbo). Novita's own pricing page the same day puts the cheap end lower still on Chinese-vendor models: GLM-4.7-Flash $0.07/$0.40, GLM-4.5-Air $0.13/$0.85, ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B $0.07/$0.28, Stheno-8B $0.05/$0.05. Batch API 50% off both directions on supported models. provider='other' per the enum; the record name carries the provider.
notes: The cheap-API outlier this phase was told to hunt: Novita undercuts Together ~7.7x on the same Llama 3.3 70B ($0.135 vs $1.04 input) and runs at 41 tok/s measured - mid-pack speed, floor-tier price. 200+ models including GPU-instance rental alongside the token API; the GPU hourly side is supply-type data. Lower uptime than the top tier on OpenRouter's table (97.77% 3d vs Groq's 100%), which is part of what the discount buys.
